item.title: Added · Shared Public Way paseo (Dr Maya Angelou Lane, north segment): The Shared Public Way paseo between The Canyon and the Visa building added on its real lot. The 2019 Phase 1 submittal planned it as part of Phase 1; the Port Commission's Feb 11, 2025 minutes record staff's request to accept Phase 1's public infrastructure, including the paseos around Building G (Resolutions 25-05, 25-06), and the Port's June 2026 report says Phase 1 was completed in 2025 and the City has accepted all Phase 1 public infrastructure.
item.description: The Shared Public Way paseo between The Canyon and the Visa building added on its real lot. The 2019 Phase 1 submittal planned it as part of Phase 1; the Port Commission's Feb 11, 2025 minutes record staff's request to accept Phase 1's public infrastructure, including the paseos around Building G (Resolutions 25-05, 25-06), and the Port's June 2026 report says Phase 1 was completed in 2025 and the City has accepted all Phase 1 public infrastructure. Source: 2019 Phase 1 submittal; Port Commission minutes, Feb 11 2025 (sfport.com/media/10214); Port Item 8B memo, Oct 6 2023 (Parcel A, The Canyon; Parcel G Visa); Port Item 11A memo, June 5 2026; DataSF Parcels.
item.source: 2019 Phase 1 submittal; Port Commission minutes, Feb 11 2025 (sfport.com/media/10214); Port Item 8B memo, Oct 6 2023 (Parcel A, The Canyon; Parcel G Visa); Port Item 11A memo, June 5 2026; DataSF Parcels

item.title: Added · Pier 70 Waterfront Open Space (Waterfront Terrace / Slipways Commons / Waterfront Promenade / Pier 70 Shoreline): Pier 70's shoreline open space (Waterfront Terrace, Slipways Commons, Waterfront Promenade, Pier 70 Shoreline) added as one combined record; the D4D figures used draw no line between them. The event date is the Port Commission's Sept 26, 2017 approval of the Pier 70 mixed-use project including the D4D (Port Item 12B, Resolution 20-07: 'On September 26, 2017, the Port Commission approved a mixed-use development project'), not a date in the D4D itself.
